title: Petition of KeySpan Energy Delivery New England for waiver from the Provisions of 49 C.F.R. 192 for Uprating the Maximum Allowable Operating Pressure of Segments of the Bourne Line, Cape Cod.
filings: ORDER: Issued by Commissioners Afonso (Chairman), Connelly, Keating, Manning, Sullivan. DTE 04-67

Petition of KeySpan Energy Delivery New England for Waiver, requesting the Department of Telecommunications and Energy to allow KeySpan to increase the MAOP of segments of a high-pressure, gas distribution main on Cape Cod from 200 psig to 270 psig. By David E. Weber, P.E. DTE 04-67
